Open when the box wakes up
Return to OwnTV after wake, including from the home screen. Requires the automatic-start service.

Enable OwnTV automatic start in Accessibility. This optional service listens for wake events and opens OwnTV. It does not read screen content or control your remote. You can disable it at any time. Box firmware may restrict automatic opening.
Open Accessibility in the box system settings and enable OwnTV automatic start.
